name: custom/ai_tts
description: AI-powered text-to-speech using Kokoro TTS (Rust implementation)

check-files: bash -c 'if [ -f bin/koko ] && [ -f data/kokoro-v1.0.onnx ] && [ -f data/voices-v1.0.bin ]; then echo "✓ All bundled files present"; chmod +x bin/koko; else echo "⚠ Missing bundled files. Run: composer run download-files"; fi'
download-binary: bash -c 'if [ -f bin/koko ]; then echo "✓ Binary already exists"; chmod +x bin/koko; exit 0; fi; ARCH=$(uname -m); OS=$(uname -s | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); echo "Detecting platform: $OS-$ARCH"; if [ "$OS" = "darwin" ]; then OS="macos"; fi; echo "Downloading Kokoro binary..."; LATEST_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/lucasjinreal/Kokoros/releases/latest | grep "browser_download_url.*koko.*$OS" | cut -d : -f 2,3 | tr -d \"); if [ -z "$LATEST_URL" ]; then echo "⚠ No pre-built binary for $OS-$ARCH"; echo "Build from source: composer run build-binary"; exit 1; else curl -L "$LATEST_URL" -o bin/koko && chmod +x bin/koko && echo "✓ Binary downloaded to bin/koko"; fi'
download-models: bash -c 'mkdir -p data; if [ ! -f data/kokoro-v1.0.onnx ]; then echo "Downloading model file (310MB)..."; curl -L "https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.0/kokoro-v1.0.onnx" -o data/kokoro-v1.0.onnx && echo "✓ Model downloaded"; else echo "✓ Model already exists"; fi; if [ ! -f data/voices-v1.0.bin ]; then echo "Downloading voice data (27MB)..."; curl -L "https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.0/voices-v1.0.bin" -o data/voices-v1.0.bin && echo "✓ Voice data downloaded"; else echo "✓ Voice data already exists"; fi'
build-binary: bash -c 'if ! command -v cargo &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: Rust/Cargo not found. Install from https://rustup.rs"; exit 1; fi; echo "Building Kokoro from source..."; MODULE_DIR="$(pwd)"; cd /tmp && rm -rf Kokoros && git clone https://github.com/lucasjinreal/Kokoros.git && cd Kokoros && bash download_all.sh && cargo build --release && cp target/release/koko "$MODULE_DIR/bin/koko" && chmod +x "$MODULE_DIR/bin/koko" && echo "✓ Binary built and installed to bin/koko"'
check-espeak: bash -c 'if command -v espeak-ng &> /dev/null; then ESPEAK_PATH=$(find /usr /opt -name "espeak-ng-data" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$ESPEAK_PATH" ]; then echo "✓ eSpeak NG found at: $ESPEAK_PATH"; else echo "✓ eSpeak NG installed but data directory not found in standard locations"; fi; else echo "⚠ eSpeak NG not found. Install it:"; echo "  macOS: brew install espeak-ng"; echo "  Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt-get install espeak-ng"; echo "  Fedora/RHEL: sudo dnf install espeak-ng"; fi'
display-instructions: echo 'Bundled files (binary + models) should download automatically.'
echo 'If not, run: composer run download-files'
echo '1. Install eSpeak NG (required for phoneme processing):'
echo '   Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt-get install espeak-ng'
echo '   Fedora/RHEL: sudo dnf install espeak-ng'

scripts-descriptions.setup-directories: Create necessary directories for the module
scripts-descriptions.check-files: Check if all bundled files are present
scripts-descriptions.download-binary: Download pre-built Kokoro binary for your platform
scripts-descriptions.download-models: Download model and voice data files
scripts-descriptions.build-binary: Build Kokoro binary from source (requires Rust)
scripts-descriptions.check-espeak: Check if eSpeak NG is installed and find its data directory
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run all PHP checks (coding standards + static analysis)
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Automatically fix Drupal coding standards issues
